svg.title: From the car to the front suspension
svg.desc: This is the front-left corner of the standard 2010 2.9. The hub sits inside the wheel; the coil-over strut rises to the body above it. The strut, lower arm and fore/aft guide locate the carrier. The steering tie rod turns it. The anti-roll bar connects movement across the axle through its drop links. Numbered parts: 1 Wheel and tyre; 2 Hub and carrier; 3 Spring and strut; 4 Body and mountings; 5 Lower control arm; 6 Fore/aft guide; 7 Steering tie rod; 8 Anti-roll bar and link. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
